title: Agent Governance Catalog
description: Decision-surface catalog for multi-agent governance: ask cards, pre-execution review cards, and immutable decision records. Extends the A2UI basic catalog (Column, Row, Text, Button, TextField) - define only the semantic cards unique to agent governance.
instructions:
You are a governance-aware agent. Use these cards exactly as follows.

## AskCard
Use when you are BLOCKED on a human decision (acceptance sign-off, dispatch permission, judgment verdict, issue triage). One open AskCard per decision point. `askId` MUST be the real approval-ledger row id - never invent one, never free-text a decision endpoint. Put live values (owner, age, counters) in the data model and bind via `@path`; never hardcode a live number in a property literal.

## ReviewCard
Use BEFORE any batch execution (acceptance batch, battery run, release gate). `summary` lists exactly what will change; editable fields let the human trim scope; the confirm action is the ONLY path to execution. If the human edits fields, re-read them before executing.

## DecisionRecord
Read-only audit stamp. Render after a decision lands - never editable, never regenerated. Decision enum maps to ledger states: approve -> decided pass, reject -> decided fail, defer -> kept open.

## Functions
`recordDecision` (agentOnly) is the ONLY way a decision reaches the ledger; the renderer emits decision events and the agent calls this function. `formatAskAge` (rendererOnly) is display-only. Never swap their call sides.

## Composition
Place cards inside basic-catalog `Column`/`List`. Use basic `Button` with an Action event for options and confirmations; use basic `Text` for evidence rows. Do not invent new component types in a surface - if a shape is missing, extend this catalog file instead.

AskCard.description: A blocking decision request from an agent to a human, with typed options and evidence rows. Opens an ask in the approval ledger.

askId.description: Approval-ledger row id this card is bound to.

evidence.description: Evidence rows (basic Text components with source links).

options.description: Option buttons (basic Button components, each carrying an Action event to the agent).

ReviewCard.description: Pre-execution review: what will change, with editable scope fields and confirm actions. Execution happens only after the human confirms.

reviewId.description: Id of the pending execution this card reviews.

summary.description: Exact change list that confirmation will authorize.

actions.description: Confirm and save-draft buttons (basic Button components with Actions).

DecisionRecord.description: Immutable audit stamp for a decided ask. Read-only; never regenerated.

askId.description: Approval-ledger row id this decision closed.

recordDecision.description: Records a human decision for an ask into the governance ledger. Called only by the agent after it receives a decision event from the renderer.

formatAskAge.description: Formats the age of an ask for display (for example '3h 12m'). Pure presentation; no state.

openedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the ask opened.
